criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Dark-field renders with light type and no plates; 2, 4 and 5 strongest. 3 a straight-on plan close under the dek; 7 a uniform dark-grey field bleeding off both edges so the 860 can't be counted, label outside the safe zone; 8's racks bare wireframe primitives on a mid-grey pool; 9's two lowest bars duller teal.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One hall, one cold flood, the tray motif changing state and a cyan accent for Vista. 4 and 5 in a charcoal bench register; 7 outside both; 6 and 9 near twins.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; the comparison carried as one lab's account. Looser: frame 9's 'Frontera is dark. The work moved.' an unbounded headline on one anecdote; frame 2's two Xeons per node and the caption's opener give no set; frame 2 states TACC's superlative as fact; frame 7's bleeding field can't be checked against 'one cell per node'; '860' present tense from a 2024 release. HPCwire reprints acceptable, not ideal. No hard fail.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and where; no decision, body or deadline; stake a general closing question; 4 and 5 never return to it.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns a swipe; 2 steps back; 3 restates the cover; the turn at 6 lands; 4 and 5 could fold; the close overclaims.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, sober, honest hedging; thin regional specificity; frame 8 reads as release copy.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh subject and motif; cold night flood as no. 70, one unit per thing counted relief, numeral comparison cover.

one_sentence_fix: Bound frame 9's closing headline to what the claims say.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Uniform dark-grey field bleeding off both edges, the eight tiny, label outside the safe zone.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull the field inside the frame with a lit border, darker, raking key; label inside the margin.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Bare wireframe racks on a mid-grey pool.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Crop in on the half filled tower with lit chamfers; tight pool.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Straight-on plan reads as a keyboard; carrier tight under the dek.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Tilt off plan 15 to 20 degrees; drop the carrier 60 px.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Two lowest cyan bars duller teal.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: One emissive value on all eight bars.
